ns2:section.sectionText: CWL 571 for Fall 2018, "Literature, Violence, and the Archive" will explore concepts and practices of witnessing, documentation and the archive, especially as they pertain to mass, public violence in periods of political upheaval. Theoretical works from a number of disciplines, including visual studies, and non-fiction and fiction texts will be the main focus. Consideration will also be given to the biopolitical concept of "creaturely life." Will meet in English 109
